# Instrumentation Manual

Manufacturer: Emerson

Model: 3051TG

## 3.2 Hydraulic System

The Pressure Sensor is connected to the Pressure Transmitter PT-4501.

Operating range: 0-5000 psi.

The Temperature Sensor reports Temperature in degC.

Identifier: LOOP-PT-4501

Alias local pressure also referred to as Local Pressure.
